scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,DESKTOP" -c "blue,green,magenta" "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run dev:frontend" "pnpm run dev:electron"
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm run lint:backend
scripts.format:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format: pnpm --filter frontend format && pnpm run format:backend
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && uv run python scripts/reset_environment.py
